annotations.title: EVE Frontier On-Chain Killmail Threat & Gatecamp Ambush Analyzer

description: Analyzes on-chain EVE Frontier killmail.move events in a solar system to quantify gatecamp ambush probability and identify dominant hostile hull doctrines. Use when assessing solar system PvP danger before jumping a hauler or fleet into a system; for computing real-time weapon target-lock priorities during active grid combat, use prioritize_eve_turret_targets instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'system_id' ('time_window' defaults to '1h'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (30 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

system_id.description: Solar system identifier to analyze for recent killmail activity (e.g. 'System-Frontier-01').

time_window.description: Historical lookback window for killmail aggregation; defaults to '24h' when omitted.

name: analyze_eve_killmail_threats

ambush_probability.description: Estimated probability (0.0 to 1.0) of an active stargate camp.

killmails_24h.description: Total verified ship destructions recorded in the window.

title: EVE Frontier On-Chain Killmail Threat & Gatecamp Ambush Analyzer
